definitions: To be in a difficult situation where one has to choose between two equally unpleasant or undesirable options.
To be in a dilemma with no easy solution.
examples: She got stuck between a rock and a hard place when both her friends asked her to their parties on the same night.
The company was stuck between a rock and a hard place: either lay off employees or face bankruptcy.
He felt he was stuck between a rock and a hard place, having to choose between his career and his family.
lemma: get stuck between a rock and a hard place
synonyms: between the devil and the deep blue sea
on the horns of a dilemma
source: get stuck between a rock and a hard place
